annotations.title: List FRC Districts for a Year

description: List every active FRC district for a given season year (FIRST in Michigan 'fim', New England 'ne', Chesapeake 'chs', Pacific Northwest 'pnw', FIRST In Texas 'fit', Indiana 'in', Ontario 'ont', Israel 'isr', etc.). Returns each district's abbreviation, display name, district key, and year.

year.description: FRC competition season year. FRC began in 1992 and runs one game per year (e.g., 2023 = "Charged Up", 2024 = "Crescendo", 2025 = "Reefscape"). Must be between 1992 and next calendar year.

name: get_districts
